messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INCIDENT P-98217 fired -> HTTP 5xx error rate spike on inference-gateway (route: /v1/generate). Affected regions: eu-west1, us-central1. Current 5xx rate: 6.8% (threshold 1.0%). Pager: @ben (on-call). Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P-98217

ben (on-call): acked. i'm on it. starting triage — looking at dashboards and recent deploys.

ben (on-call): quick look: errors are 502/504 predominantly, not auth. latency also increased ~30%.

alice (sre): pinging traces. any recent rollout?

maria (prod-eng): no prod rollouts in last 4h. there was a model-variant promotion earlier today but that was to canary only.

chao (infra): checking infra alarms — autoscaler shows several short-lived OOMs on gpu-pool-3 in eu-west1. Could be memory pressure causing worker restarts -> 502.

ben (on-call): good catch. pulling the kube events and pod logs for inference-gateway.

ben (on-call): logs (snippet):
```
2026-11-05T14:12:03Z inference-gateway pod/gw-5f4b8 stderr: [error] KV cache miss -> falling back to recompute
2026-11-05T14:12:04Z inference-gateway pod/gw-5f4b8 stderr: Fatal: allocator OOM while processing batch
2026-11-05T14:12:04Z inference-runtime pod/rt-9c2d1 stderr: upstream returned 502
```

alice (sre): sounds like memory spike leading to OOMs and upstream 502. can we scale the GPU pool as a mitigation?

chao (infra): scaling up dedicated GPU nodes in eu-west1 by +4 now. starting new nodes — ETA ~3m. also increasing pod replicas with temporary relaxed resource limits.

maria (prod-eng): can we fallback traffic to a smaller quantized model variant (v1.2-q8) to reduce memory pressure? That should reduce per-request memory and latency.

ben (on-call): routing policy update: adding model fallback for non-high-priority traffic to v1.2-q8 in eu-west1 and us-central1. applying routing rule now.

pagerduty-bot: User ben acknowledged incident P-98217 at 2026-11-05T14:13:10Z. Escalation paused.

ben (on-call): applied fallback routing and bumped replicas. watching metrics. 5xx rate dropping to 3.1% — still elevated but improving.

alice (sre): adding temporary circuit-breaker on upstream cache miss path to avoid catastrophic retries. pushing config to gateway.

chao (infra): new GPU nodes are up in eu-west1; autoscaler health checks passing. node count +4.

ben (on-call): 5xx now 0.9% in eu-west1, 1.2% in us-central1. global 5xx ~1.05% — close to threshold. keeping page for now until stable for 10m.

maria (prod-eng): customer impact check: top 10 customers show increased error counts but only 2 customers saw >3% of requests failing. contacting CS to notify those customers.

alice (sre): started a short-lived debug job to capture heap profiles from the failing pods; uploading to shared S3: s3://redwood-debug/p-98217/heap-20261105.tgz

ben (on-call): creating a short status blurb for #general and CS: "We experienced a transient 5xx spike affecting inference-gateway. Root cause appears to be memory pressure on GPU pool leading to OOMs; we mitigated by scaling nodes and routing low-priority traffic to a quantized model. Error rate is returning to normal, monitoring for stability. Follow-up postmortem to come." :eyes:

maria (prod-eng): agreed. i'll coordinate customer comms with support.

alice (sre): will keep tracing and heap captures; if stable for 15m we can start controlled rollback of temporary limits and routing.

ben (on-call): handoff: i'm staying on for the next 20m. if it stays stable, i'll mark as resolved and create the incident ticket for postmortem (include memory profiles, autoscaler metrics, model promotion timeline).

incident-bot: Note: Incident P-98217 currently acked and in progress. Escalation policy suspended.

ben (on-call): thanks team — cc @chao for infra follow-up and @alice for SRE investigation. I'll update the incident record and tag for a 1-hour postmortem.

chao (infra): leaving a note in infra-runbook: temporarily raised GPU pool size to mitigate OOM cascade; need to investigate pod memory defaults and batching config.

alice (sre): if anyone sees a spike again, call the pager.

maria (prod-eng): filing a customer-impact ticket and notifying the two affected customers now.

ben (on-call): last check 5xx 0.6% global. marking last_message_ts = 1901726610. will close after 15m stable.

incident-bot: Incident P-98217 updated: last activity by ben.
